item.title: Russian hackers target Signal, WhatsApp in global cyber campaign
item.description: "Russian state hackers are engaged in a large-scale global cyber campaign to gain access to Signal and WhatsApp accounts belonging to dignitaries, military personnel and civil servants," Dutch intelligence agencies said March 9.

item.title: Putin, Trump discuss Iran war, Ukraine in phone call
item.description: Russian President Vladimir Putin and U.S. President Donald Trump spoke by phone on March 9, according to Kremlin aide Yuri Ushakov. During the call, Putin reportedly presented proposals aimed at resolving the war in Iran.

item.title: US waiving oil-related sanctions to reduce prices, Trump says
item.description: U.S. President Donald Trump said March 9 that the U.S. is preparing to waive certain oil-related sanctions in an effort to stabilize global energy prices.

item.title: France, allies preparing mission to escort ships through Strait of Hormuz, Macron says
item.description: French President Emmanuel Macron said on March 9 that France and its partners are preparing a naval mission to escort commercial vessels through the Strait of Hormuz, once the most intense phase of the U.S.-Israeli conflict with Iran subsides.

item.title: Overnight Russian attacks on Dnipro and Kharkiv injure at least 20
item.description: Russian overnight attacks on March 10 struck the Ukrainian cities of Dnipro and Kharkiv, leaving at least 20 people injured as emergency crews continue assessing the damage.
